page: Microsoft Azure NV36adms_A10_v5 is a GPU-accelerated and memory-intensive virtual machine instance based on the AMD x86_64 architecture and managed by Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 36 dedicated vCPUs and 880.0 GB of system memory, yielding an extensive memory-to-core ratio of 24.44 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local ephemeral storage comprises 3092 GB of solid-state drive (SSD) capacity, complemented by support for Azure Premium Storage to handle auxiliary disk throughput requirements.

The instance reflects an architectural design tailored to workloads requiring substantial system memory coupled with moderate graphical or parallel acceleration. By pairing 880 GB of RAM with a single GPU, the configuration avoids the overhead of multi-GPU topologies when a single accelerator suffices for the primary compute or display pipeline.

This hardware balance makes the NV36adms_A10_v5 suited for large-dataset 3D visualization, virtual workstation hosting, computer-aided design, seismic processing, and in-memory data analytics pipelines that require GPU acceleration alongside large local scratch disks.
